mapper.select: SELECT APPLICANT_ANSWER_NO , RECRUIT_EXAM_NO , RECRUIT_QUESTIONS_NO , APPLICANT_ID , APPLICANT_SCORE FROM APPLICANT_ANSWER
SELECT APPLICANT_ANSWER_NO , RECRUIT_EXAM_NO , RECRUIT_QUESTIONS_NO , APPLICANT_ID , APPLICANT_OPTION_NO , APPLICANT_SCORE FROM APPLICANT_ANSWER WHERE APPLICANT_ANSWER_NO = #{applicantAnswerNo}

SELECT aa.APPLICANT_ID AS applicantId, SUM(aa.APPLICANT_SCORE) AS totalScore, e.RECRUIT_EXAM_CUTLINE AS cutlineScore, CASE WHEN SUM(aa.APPLICANT_SCORE) >= e.RECRUIT_EXAM_CUTLINE THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS passYn FROM APPLICANT_ANSWER aa JOIN RECRUITMENT_EXAM e ON aa.RECRUIT_EXAM_NO = e.RECRUIT_EXAM_NO WHERE aa.RECRUIT_EXAM_NO = #{recruitExamNo} AND aa.APPLICANT_ID = #{applicantId} GROUP BY aa.APPLICANT_ID, e.RECRUIT_EXAM_CUTLINE
